SC-001.evidence: T007 runs four rg checks asserting exact P1..P7 continuity, P7 detail-heading presence, [impact-audit] template presence, and ≥3 total P7 occurrences — sufficient for the <60s reviewer-locate criterion. Checkpoint US1 explicitly names SC-001.

SC-002.evidence: T013 explicitly checks `rg -n '^(description|globs|alwaysApply|tags):' ... → 4 matches in the first 15 lines (SC-002)`.

SC-003.evidence: T013 includes 'Manual read for ordered 1. do X, 2. do Y recipe blocks (SC-003) → zero such blocks'; T015 re-asserts the same manual check in the final integrity sweep.

SC-004.evidence: T013 runs `test -f rules/07-quality-assurance/7-testing.mdc && test -f rules/05-workflows-and-processes/5-spec-driven-dev.mdc` (both targets exist); T015 then re-confirms both cross-refs are present inside the new file via rg.

SC-005.evidence: Out-of-band — SC-005 measures reviewer behaviour on the NEXT TWO downstream specs; cannot be verified by this tasks file by construction. Not a gap of this tasks.md.

T015 re-confirms the same match as part of the final integrity sweep.
